name: Nagumo Itsuki
source:
Hakuto's twin brother, the younger. He's a brilliant student, with a strong sense of honor and a great pride; he dislikes being in company of anyone -- even and foremost his brother whom he hates -- save one person. His comrades fear him and he's frequently staying outdoor late at night, sometimes even fighting with bad kids. 

[From [url=http://renai.gwathyr.net/pictures/CH/]renai.gwathyr.net[/url]]
